experiment: Phase (a) byte-order verdict — Risiko #1 CLOSED off-GPU (Kanban #32/#30/#31, night 2026-08-20/21)
method: Transitive off-GPU proof: vLLM's dequant_nvfp4_kv_cache (tests/kernels/quantization/nvfp4_utils.py) is verified against the REAL GPU writer reshape_and_cache_nvfp4 in tests/kernels/attention/test_cache.py (torch.testing.assert_close). Running the shim's CPU reference (dequant_nvfp4_side_reference) vs dequant_nvfp4_kv_cache on identical bytes proves shim-vs-real-page agreement WITHOUT a GPU. Pure torch 2.7.0 CPU on the Mac.
harness: byteorder_cpu_proof.py (verbatim copies of both dequant paths + break_fp4_bytes + kE2M1)

nibble_order.verdict: MATCH — shim assumption even=low-nibble + E2M1 LUT {0,.5,1,1.5,2,3,4,6} is CORRECT vs vLLM break_fp4_bytes (low=a&0x0F even, high=(a&0xF0)>>4 odd)

block_scale_layout.verdict: MISMATCH — vLLM stores block scales 4x4-SWIZZLED across the (block_size, scale_dim) plane (dequant_nvfp4_kv_cache unswizzle: reshape (T//4,4,sg,4) -> permute -> (T,S)); the shim's _gather_block_scale reads them LINEARLY (scale_vec[elem//16]). => shim produces WRONG drafter KV on real vLLM pages.

fix_validated_off_gpu.change: add the 4x4 SF unswizzle to the shim scale read (mirror dequant_nvfp4_kv_cache) before the per-16 linear broadcast
fix_validated_off_gpu.verdict: MATCH — corrected shim reference == vLLM exactly. Reference-level fix proven; Triton-kernel port (_gather_block_scale must unswizzle) still needs GPU validation.

why_prior_selfconsistent_tests_passed: The shim's 14/14 off-GPU unit tests packed pages with the shim's OWN linear layout (self-consistent), so they proved the MATH but not vLLM's true scale byte order — exactly the RUNBOOK step-(c) caveat. This is the first vLLM-faithful check.
impact_on_A_vs_B: Option B (dequant shim) is NOT real-page-correct as shipped (missing 4x4 SF unswizzle) — a concrete, fixable correctness bug, not a math error. B-first ordering still holds but B needs this fix + GPU byte-order confirmation before it is a green correctness gate.
gpu_note: This verdict needed NO GPU. The A-numerics real-page test (fa2 causal=False vs bf16) and the in-tree Triton gate DO need GPU; blocked this window (see verdict json / window note).
